limitations: Only one synchronized time instant: other-agent motion is ambiguous without temporal history or explicit velocity sensing.
Hidden agents, occluded signal state and future light changes cannot become observed facts merely by training predictive memory.
Frozen Qwen may omit small signal/visibility cues; trainable memory cannot guarantee recovery of information absent from its inputs.

Removing IL auxiliary losses can allow latent semantic drift; action mean anchoring does not directly preserve object/future/post-task accuracy. This is a hypothesis for diagnosis, not an established cause.

data_selection_design.current_stage_policy: no sealed stage or current adaptive recipe changed
future_sampling_design: Preserve a broad uniform exploration floor; select context-specific safety failures and low-risk inefficiency separately instead of globally increasing/decreasing speed.
Do not label required red/queue stops as low-score hard negatives; do not prioritize only absolute low score.
Use only current-policy TRAIN feedback with matching sampler identity; FULL diagnostics cannot silently become ADAPT current-policy bank.

Use within-context coverage, bounded scene repetition, stage-specific versioned manifests and an uncertainty bucket; choose quotas after observed stratum counts rather than declare arbitrary optimal percentages.
Previous80/10/10 replay describes a low-score/regression mixture. Replacing those components with contextual safety/efficiency is a different registered recipe and needs its own evidence.
data_selection_design.legal_population: TRAIN/NAVTRAIN103288 including oldDEV training diagnostics; NAVTEST tokens/failure lists excluded
next_CPU_diagnosis: Build current-condition labels by reading each TRAIN raw log once; use static cached geometry only when needed. Start with existing4096 paired rows.
Compare IL70/FULL10k/ADAPT10k within each context: NC/DAC/TTC incidents, EP, raw progress, safe-opportunity gaps; cluster by162physical logs and label small strata clearly.
Split original feedback1024, extra3072, and actual training exposure; do not call all extras unseen or heldout.
Keep current-condition features, future-outcome labels and policy-generated witness fields in separate columns with provenance/time index.
data_selection_design.possible_representation_experiment: If current visible cues exist but latent scene distinctions drift, a separately registered small current-object auxiliary retention term is a hypothesis. It is not active today and should not be conflated with changing data, reward and Qwen unfreezing simultaneously.

reward_readout_semantics.TTC_semantics: candidate future simulated infraction metric/time, not actor current risk estimate
reward_readout_semantics.normalization: Official reference+one candidate; safety-masked progress. If maximum masked raw progress<=5m, safe candidates receive EP1. Low meters alone therefore need not mean inefficiency.
reward_readout_semantics.primary_new_focus: scene-conditioned safety versus progress/efficiency; comfort remains an ancillary recorded metric
reward_readout_semantics.red_cache_caveat: Although PDMObservation class supports red-light polygons, this canonical cache builder uses update_detections_tracks(GT tracks), which does not add signal polygons. Do not infer green from absent red_light tokens. Reference planner uses current traffic lights; canonical feedback has no separate red-light violation field.
